title: Painful Decision
paragraphs: “Spear Hero, don’t you have any idea? The similarities between this Filolial, Sakura, and Filo?”
“None at all!”
The Raph species’ big sister looked at me with irritation. She looks like Father from the first world. I felt a chill run down my spine.
“Whatever. Let’s put that aside for now. Is there some kind of problem?”

“There is. Since this world was activated by the Spear Hero’s obsession, it affects the branching of worlds. Whether it’s escaping or rewriting this world, that obsession must be resolved first, or the loop will continue endlessly. Since the objective hasn’t been achieved.”
“Wait… so Motoyasu isn’t trying to save the world but just wants to meet that Filolial…?”
“Then what have we been fighting for…?”
“Either way, this world will be reset… So, it’s decided. Motoyasu-kun, unless you meet Filo, we can neither move forward nor stay where we are.”
“If we forcibly pull the Spear Hero out using power, the enemy will notice.”
Father and the others looked at me and Sakura-chan.
“If Sakura-chan pretends to be this Filo, would that resolve the obsession?”
“Gaelion can use ancient magic to forcibly change her.”
“Nooo!”
“That won’t work. Even the slightest discrepancy is enough to make it fail. It has to be a perfect replica of Filo. And bringing the real Filo into this world is difficult…”
“Is that so?”

“Yes… Since existing elements are repelled, Naofumi-san’s presence is preventing Naofumi-sama from entering. It’s not impossible to force it, but the enemy would notice. The reason I can forcibly maintain this form is because the Raph species is acknowledged by this world, but Naofumi-san didn’t create them here.”
It seems like there’s a complicated reason behind all this. The absence of the Raph species seems to work in big sister’s favor.
“So, because Sakura-chan is a similar entity, it’s impossible to bring Filo here?”
“That’s correct. And the egg that gave birth to Filo existed before the Heroes were summoned, so we can’t fake it like we did when I entered this world.”
“How troublesome. And with Sakura-chan here, it’s as if the failure has already occurred…”
“Does that mean Sakura is unnecessary?”
“That’s not true. Motoyasu-kun is just too much of a hassle.”
“Yeah. He’s seriously troublesome.”
“This is getting ridiculous.”
What was that!? I can’t just let that slide!
“But wouldn’t it be extremely difficult to make Sakura-chan become that Filo?”
“Hmm… If we forcefully use power to match them, it might be possible… but it would definitely attract attention.”
“Haah… Looks like we have no choice.”
Father let out a sigh and looked at me. What is it, Father?
“Motoyasu-kun, in the next loop, don’t save me. You need to recreate the exact situation from the first world.”
What did Father just say? Recreate the exact situation from the first world?

“Remember this well. No matter how good of a situation you create, in this world, nothing can be achieved or ended. This world will keep looping endlessly… To stop it, Motoyasu-kun, you need to reunite with that Filo.”

What!? So, does this mean that this situation, where Father has such a gentle expression, cannot be acknowledged? No matter what happens, will this spear deny it? It reminds me of the inscription I read in a past loop: “Accept the bitter choice.” But I’ll smash through that! I want to say that, but Father continues, as if trying to reason with me.

“For Rifana’s wish, for Raphtalia-chan, for the world… and most importantly, for Motoyasu-kun to return to the original world, you have to meet that girl, Filo. Even if Raphtalia leaves you behind, once the enemy is defeated, the spear will have fulfilled its role. What will happen to you then?”
“I don’t know. But I could never abandon Father!”
“I’m not telling you to abandon anyone. I want you to help the me from the original world.”
What!? So Father’s wish is for me to protect the Father from the first world! In that case, I’m getting fired up!

“Motoyasu-kun… it’s because you saved me that I have to ask this of you. Things can’t go on like this. If you stay as you are, you’ll wither away along with this world. That’s why… I need you to walk the path that leads to the birth of that girl, Filo.”
“…There are many problems, but the biggest hurdle is that I obtained Filo through the egg lottery, right?”
“I’ll have to get the slave trader to make some adjustments there. Since it seems like we know where Sakura-chan’s egg is, we can manipulate things when I obtain that Filo.”
Oh… Father is giving me instructions on what looks to be a rather difficult part.
“When the loop happens, it seems I’ll be temporarily expelled from the world, so I’ll need to re-enter. I’ll try to get back in as quickly as possible, but there might be a slight time lag.”
“Either way, we’ll have to make sure Motoyasu-kun meets that Filo girl before Raphtalia comes. And we’ll have to wait until the next loop…”
“No, I think we can rewind things by interfering with the spear. Worst-case scenario, we just have to wait until the right time…”
“For Motoyasu-kun, this loop… might not have any meaning left. If possible, it’d be better for him to act sooner.”
“But Naofumi-san, if we do that, wouldn’t that mean we’re basically walking toward our deaths…?” Itsuki asked Father anxiously.
Father gave everyone a gentle smile.

“We won’t die. This world… is just a dream-like place for Motoyasu-kun, a place that’s different from the afterlife. We’re like characters in a dream… There’s no such thing as death here. There’s even a chance Raphtalia-chan’s prediction could be wrong.”
“Even coming from someone who can do things on par with a god?”

“There are plenty of stories about defying all-knowing, all-powerful gods. Even gods aren’t omnipotent. If we didn’t believe that, we wouldn’t be able to go on, Ren. Whether it happens sooner or later, the end is inevitable. The only thing that changes is how long Motoyasu-kun remembers us.”
Father gave me a gentle smile, as if he had accepted everything.

“There was a game I played a long time ago where the protagonist wandered into a dream world and had to wake up the creature that was dreaming it. This is that kind of dream world… If Motoyasu-kun doesn’t wake up, he’ll die. I want to accept whatever needs to be done for Motoyasu-kun to wake up.”

Father… He’s speaking as if he understands death. I’ve met many versions of Father from different worlds. It feels like I can hear their voices, urging me to move forward and help the Father from the original world.
“It’s a strange feeling… understanding how that game character must have felt.”
Then, Father turns his gaze toward big sister’s friend, Rival, and Sakura-chan.
“…By the way, these people are…”
Itsuki looks at the three and falls silent.
“According to Motoyasu and Raphtalia from the original world… Rifana seems to understand from the conversation earlier, but…” Ren murmurs, looking uncomfortable and averting his gaze.
“Aww… it’s over now. I wanted to have more fun…” Rival responds to Father with a gentle expression that seems filled with disappointment, regret, or perhaps frustration.

In the original world, Rival was completely different —a male. Without a doubt, judging from Rival’s background, there’s a high chance they’re dead. In other words, just like big sister’s friend, they don’t exist in the original world.
“I thought Gaelion would try to get in the way or at least say something like, ‘I won’t die until I take Naofumi’s virginity.’”

“That’s underestimating Gaelion too much. Even Gaelion knew that the end would come someday. Originally, Gaelion should have sacrificed himself to prevent the world from being overwritten, but thanks to the Spear Hero, everything was ruined.”
Such a careless remark. Then, Rival glanced at me briefly before returning their gaze to Father.
“Gaelion doesn’t intend to disappear that easily. He’s stored his memories and power in the spear, so there’s a chance… maybe just one, that he can reach the original world.”
“Ahaha… Gaelion-chan is pretty tough.”
“Of course! I’ll do my best to meet the wild Naofumi from the original world.”
“I won’t allow it!”
When I respond, Father stops me with a calm “Now, now.”
“Well… just don’t overdo it. And… try not to take advantage of the weakened me in the next world or interfere with Motoyasu-kun and the others.”
“…You figured that out, huh.”
Rival sticks their tongue out playfully at Father. So that’s what they were planning?
“So, don’t do anything like that… I mean… maybe just a little…”
Father seems a bit embarrassed. Just a little… What does he mean by that?
“Does that mean I get one shot!?”
“No, not that far… Well… since it’s the end, how about this?”

With a resigned look, Father placed his hand gently on Rival’s cheek and, before I could stop him… kissed Rival on the forehead. Gwaaahhhhhhh! Father… doing something like that… This is a massive NTR!
“Wh-what—!?”
“I’m giving you my first kiss in this world, so bear with it. If you manage to reach the original world, do your best.”
“Yay! I got Naofumi’s first kiss! Now, even if Gaelion fails, I can accept it!”
Rival is absolutely thrilled. In contrast, Father looks a bit lonely.
“Was that too dramatic…? Ugh, now I feel really embarrassed…”
Is that so? I used to feel that way before I awakened to true love, didn’t I?
